description: React component for handling desktop authentication tokens in Mattermost, including login flow, URL handling, and UI messages.

classes.name: DesktopAuthStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing various authentication states for desktop login flow.

methods.name: tryDesktopLogin
methods.description: Attempts to log in using desktop token, updates status based on success or failure.

methods.name: openExternalLoginURL
methods.description: Generates a desktop token, stores it, and opens the external login URL with token parameter.

methods.name: forwardToDesktopApp
methods.description: Redirects the browser to the desktop app protocol URL.
